The restaurant is open seven days a week from 7 am to 1 am, with a break from 7 am to 10 am on Sundays. It has a casual atmosphere with outdoor seating and provides free Wi-Fi. The menu includes a variety of options such as burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and salads. Customers can dine in or take advantage of the take-out service.
